explication: Huashu Design is an agent-driven design production skill. A user prompts an agent, which applies the junior-designer workflow, brand protocol, style/advisor guidance, and asset rules to create HTML-based visuals. Those visuals branch into interactive prototypes, slide decks, motion graphics, infographics, and design variants; rendering/export scripts produce MP4, PDF, or editable PPTX artifacts. Optional cloud services provide TTS and AI video review. The tree and excerpts show orchestration and converters clearly, while some documented workflows remain represented at their exact reference paths.
